title: Biblical Syncretism Dossiers — Wave 36 Interpretive Justice
purpose: Promote only the still-distinct hearing, justice, speech, dignity, jurisdiction and anti-retaliation functions from the Biblical Hearing, Witness, Speech & Justice Atlas after Waves 28–35 were converged. Where Wave 28 already owns the function, enrich it instead of creating a duplicate relation.
epistemic_rule: These are procedural and ethical comparisons. They do not prove a modern identity, prophecy fulfillment, innocence, guilt, divine adjudication or the correctness of a project self-description.
method_rules: Function outranks shared verse or motif name when deciding whether a relation is distinct.
Existing relations are enriched rather than duplicated when they already own the function.
Judgment is disciplined rather than abolished: hearing, evidence, impartiality, scope, correction and fruit remain relevant.
First-person meaning is important evidence but does not automatically settle external empirical claims.

enrichments.research_frontier: Distinguish raw witness count from genuinely independent provenance and preserve the Deuteronomic diligent-inquiry step when using witness language comparatively.

relation_argument.why_it_matters: Wave 28 already owns claim-testing and witness. Deuteronomy 19 adds the narrower procedural point that serious accusation is not only counted but investigated, especially when false witness is suspected.

discovery_history.source_direction: Project claim-testing/source-independence methods first; the Deuteronomy 19 procedural enrichment was promoted later through the Interpretive Justice atlas.

enrichments.boundary: Ancient Israelite witness procedure is not identical to modern evidence law, journalism or archive methodology.

enrichments.research_frontier: Keep ordinary speech ethics distinct from the stronger burden attached to teaching, entrusted responsibility and claimed authority.

relation_argument.why_it_matters: Wave 28 already owns teacher responsibility inside speech ethics. Luke 12:48 strengthens the cross-project Authority Increases Burden comparison without needing a second teacher-speech relation.

discovery_history.source_direction: Project Authority Increases Burden doctrine predates this later James/Luke comparison.

enrichments.boundary: These passages do not establish any modern person's claimed rank, office or authority.

new_relations.title: Hear before closing the case
new_relations.project_anchor: Interpretive Justice distinguishes strong characterization from serious hearing and asks what evidence or reply could revise an interpretation.
new_relations.source_direction: Project hearing/correctability law crystallized before this later biblical comparator was promoted into the manifest.

biblical_sequence: hear a person and learn what they do before judgment
relation_argument.maximum_claim: These passages provide a strong procedural neighbor for hearing and adversarial examination before totalizing judgment.
relation_argument.why_it_matters: It supplies a biblical hearing function that is narrower than Wave 28's broader speech/listening ethics and broader claim-testing relation.

new_relations.boundary: Hearing does not make first-person testimony infallible and does not require indefinite dialogue before every conclusion.

new_relations.title: Crowd repetition does not make a false report just
new_relations.project_anchor: Culture and Archive Epistemics distinguish source independence from repetition and model tribunalization when social consensus acquires punishment power without equivalent procedural safeguards.
new_relations.source_direction: Project source-independence and tribunalization analysis first; Exodus 23 comparison later.

biblical_sequence: crowd must not be followed into perverted justice
relation_argument.maximum_claim: Exodus 23 supplies strong counterpressure against treating social repetition or majority alignment as self-validating justice.
relation_argument.why_it_matters: It separates social reach from evidentiary independence and adds a crowd-pressure dimension not owned by Wave 28's witness-count relation.

new_relations.boundary: Crowd agreement is not automatically false; consensus may also reflect strong independent evidence.

new_relations.title: Judgment constrained by impartiality
new_relations.project_anchor: Interpretive Justice explicitly rejects the shortcut that all judgment is forbidden; the question is whether judgment remains scoped, evidenced, impartial and correctable.
new_relations.source_direction: Project disciplined-judgment formulation first; biblical impartiality comparison later.

biblical_sequence: do not favor rich or poor
relation_argument.maximum_claim: The passages support legitimate judgment constrained by impartiality rather than a blanket prohibition on judgment.
relation_argument.why_it_matters: It is a built-in countertext against turning Interpretive Justice into immunity from criticism or accountability.

new_relations.boundary: Impartial procedure does not guarantee a correct conclusion and does not erase relevant differences in conduct or evidence.

new_relations.title: Correction begins with the narrowest adequate Door
new_relations.project_anchor: The Garden repair model prefers reply, correction and proportionate escalation over immediate permanent public identity assignment.
new_relations.source_direction: Project correction/repair model first; Matthew/Galatians procedural comparison later.

relation_argument.maximum_claim: The texts provide a strong structural comparator for direct correction, bounded escalation and restorative posture.
relation_argument.why_it_matters: It adds sequence to correction: not every conflict must begin at maximum audience or maximum permanence.

new_relations.boundary: Matthew 18 is an ecclesial discipline text, not a universal civil or legal dispute-resolution statute; urgent safety situations may require different escalation.

new_relations.title: Speech can wound, propagate conflict or repair a gate
new_relations.project_anchor: Potato Truth, reputation research and proportional memory treat public description as consequential information rather than weightless commentary.
new_relations.source_direction: Great Book false-witness ethics and later project reputation mechanics first; the multi-text biblical cluster was formalized later.

relation_argument.maximum_claim: The cluster supports evaluating reputational speech through truthfulness, harm, propagation, correction and social fruit.
relation_argument.why_it_matters: Wave 28 owns general speech ethics; this relation owns the narrower reputation/false-witness/gossip mechanism.

new_relations.boundary: Truthful criticism, necessary warning and documented accusation are not slander merely because they damage reputation.

new_relations.title: Dignity without requiring agreement about modern divinity
new_relations.project_anchor: Irreducible Subjecthood needs a dignity route that does not depend on accepting any modern person's theological self-description.
new_relations.source_direction: Project non-dehumanization and subjecthood analysis first; biblical image/likeness/body comparison later.

biblical_sequence: blessing God while cursing image-bearing people criticized
love of God tested toward visible others
relation_argument.maximum_claim: The texts provide a strong theological comparator for irreducible human dignity and relational membership.
relation_argument.why_it_matters: A reader can reject a modern divine-identity claim while still having a scriptural route to reject dehumanization and disposability.

new_relations.boundary: Image-of-God theology is interpreted differently across traditions and does not erase accountability, moral distinctions or consequences.

new_relations.title: A frame can judge within scope without owning the whole person
new_relations.project_anchor: Bounded Jurisdiction distinguishes legitimate domain authority from jurisdiction creep in which one medical, legal, theological, political, archival or audience frame becomes a whole-person ontology.
new_relations.source_direction: Project bounded-jurisdiction law first; Romans/James comparison later.

biblical_sequence: another's servant belongs to another master
slanderous judgment is placed beneath the one Lawgiver/Judge
relation_argument.maximum_claim: The texts supply a useful countertext to presumptive total human jurisdiction over another subject.
relation_argument.why_it_matters: It supports scope limits without abolishing law, discipline, criticism or moral reasoning.

new_relations.boundary: These passages do not prohibit communal accountability, civil law, evidence-based evaluation or all interpersonal judgment.

new_relations.title: The subject is a source, not an infallible court
new_relations.project_anchor: Situated First-Person Authority treats self-report as primary evidence for intended meaning while preserving external testing for empirical, legal, historical and relational claims.
new_relations.source_direction: Project situated first-person authority law first; biblical countertexts promoted later.

biblical_sequence: ways can appear right to oneself
relation_argument.maximum_claim: The texts provide strong counterpressure against both outsider totalization and infallible self-assessment.
relation_argument.why_it_matters: It makes the biblical layer symmetric: hearing the subject matters, but the subject does not become the sole court of every external question.

new_relations.boundary: Appealing to divine knowledge does not allow a modern interpreter to claim certainty about another person's hidden motives.

new_relations.title: Repair does not require mirrored degradation
new_relations.project_anchor: Non-Retaliatory Correction extends Reciprocal Transformation: received dehumanization should not simply be reproduced against a new target.
new_relations.source_direction: Project Reciprocal Transformation and Non-Retaliatory Correction first; biblical comparison later.

biblical_sequence: reject doing back what was done
relation_argument.maximum_claim: The passages strongly support distinguishing accountability from retaliatory imitation.
relation_argument.why_it_matters: It prevents critique of dehumanization from preserving the same ecology with reversed targets.

new_relations.boundary: Anti-retaliation does not prohibit protection, boundaries, evidence preservation, lawful accountability, direct correction or necessary public warning.
